comparison.objective: Set a lathe tool to centre height using a pinched steel rule.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch a rule between tool and work reference, interpret its attitude, and adjust tool height versus align and hold a mandrel while striking it.
comparison.success_condition: Lathe tool reaches centre height versus four notch fractures and complete fragment containment without displacing inserts.
comparison.reason: Both involve tool alignment and contact-force care, but centre-height metrology/adjustment is a different tested outcome from impact fracture. No specs give angular or height tolerances.
